datasets.dataset_name: EICV7 District Level Health and Living Conditions Indicators
datasets.publishing_institution: National Institute of Statistics of Rwanda (NISR)
datasets.indicator_description: District-level poverty rates, extreme poverty rates, health insurance coverage, percentage of population traveling more than 1 hour to reach health facilities, and reported chronic conditions prevalence.
datasets.distinction_notice: Official statistical aggregate survey data describing population-level socioeconomic and health access patterns. Does not contain individual patient identifiers, clinical charts, or hospital appointment records.
